GovStar | https://govstar.us | Remote (U.S. Eastern/Central Time) | Senior Full Stack Python Developer | U.S. Citizenship Required

GovStar is hiring a Senior Full Stack Python Developer to build secure, production-grade AI applications supporting U.S. national security initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who wants to stay close to the code, spending the majority of their time developing software.

We’re looking for strong experience with Python, React/TypeScript, CSS, REST APIs, SQL/PostgreSQL and NoSQL databases, plus experience with LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS.

Relevant technologies: Python, React, TypeScript, Azure OpenAI, PostgreSQL, CosmosDB, Docker, Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, LLMs, and RAG.

Requirements: U.S. citizenship • U.S. resident • Reside in Eastern or Central Time Zone • Ability to obtain government clearance • BA/BS + 15 years relevant experience (experience may substitute for education).

Compensation varies by experience and demonstrated technical capability. We’re happy to discuss compensation expectations early in the process so neither side wastes time.

GovStar benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) matching; paid time off; and an employee shares program.

To apply, email your resume and GitHub profile to nicholas.hanson@govstar.us

Please mention “Hacker News” and “Senior Full Stack Python Developer” in the subject line.

VOYGR (YC W26) | Founding Product Engineer | San Francisco | ONSITE | Full-time | $150K-$200K + 0.5%-2.0% equity

I'm Yarik, cofounder and CTO. Before this I spent 20 years in tech with 10+ years running infra, ML and search teams at Google, Meta and Apple.

We love maps and build location/businesses APIs for AI apps and agents. If ChatGPT tells you a restaurant is open and it actually closed in March, that's the problem we fix. We check whether a business still exists, whether its hours and details are right, and enrich it with what's being written about it on the web (news, articles, events). Customers get all of it through one API and we solve it for them with our models which use all available sources and ai voice agents which can confirm the information.

You'd be one of the first engineers. Some weeks that's search and ranking, some weeks it's data pipelines or evals, some weeks it's the API or something a customer asked for yesterday. You'll have a big say in what gets built, not just how.

Stack: Python, FastAPI, Postgres/PostGIS, DynamoDB, Redis, AWS (EKS), our own ML models plus LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic).

What I'm looking for: - 2+ years shipping production systems, or fewer if your background is unusual and you can show what you've built - real experience with at least one of: search/IR, large-scale data processing, ML systems, API design - you already use Claude Code, Cursor or similar as part of how you work - geo/POI data experience is a plus, not required

Fair warning: we are a small team, fast pace, and there could be nights and weekends. If that's not where you are in life right now, totally fine, this just isn't a good fit.

Process: a short note on why you, a 30 min call with me and then Vlad, a technical deep dive, then a paid trial project.

Apply here: https://www.workatastartup.com/jobs/93490 or email me directly at yarik@voygr.tech

Cleverbase | https://cleverbase.com/ | The Hague, Netherlands | ONSITE (hybrid) | Full-time

Cleverbase runs an API platform for online trust: qualified e-signatures, PKI, digital identity and high-assurance identity onboarding for European organisations. We’re now building towards the EU Digital Identity Wallet and the European Business Wallet. Helping customers design and ship their solutions on our platform matters as much to us as building the platform itself.

As a Qualified Trust Service Provider under eIDAS, what we ship has to be demonstrably correct, auditable and secure, and we still deploy frequently. We go beyond compliance by applying modern cryptography to better protect personal data, because our mission is everyone secure online.

Stack: JVM (Scala with Cats/Cats-Effect, http4s, fs2, doobie), gRPC, Postgres and HSMs for the trust services; TypeScript (React, NestJS, oRPC, Drizzle, Playwright) for web; standards like JSON/XML/PDF signatures and OpenID. Experience with this exact stack isn't required, but interest in cryptography or digital identity is.

Roles currently available:

Web Engineer (Medior): https://cleverbase.com/en/careers/web-engineer-medior/

Web Engineer (Senior): https://cleverbase.com/en/careers/web-engineer-senior/

Solution Engineer (Medior): https://cleverbase.com/en/careers/solution-engineer-medior/

Apply: email me (CTO) sander.dijkhuis@cleverbase.com with your CV and a short note, and mention that you found us through this HN post.

Mattermost | Remote (US and Canada) | FT | Multiple roles

Mattermost (https://mattermost.com) is an open-core collaboration and workflow automation platform for air-gapped, on-prem and private clouds. Our customers are in defense, intelligence, security and critical infrastructure, including the USAF and NASA. Y Combinator led our Series B, their largest open-source investment at the time.

Both openings are full stack on the core platform: Go backend, React/TypeScript frontend, PostgreSQL and Redis. The codebase is public (https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost), so most of what you build is too. We would rather hire people who ship and own complex software end to end than chase an exact stack match, so any systems or backend language and any frontend stack counts. What we look for in both roles: REST and WebSocket APIs with real networking fundamentals (HTTP, connection lifecycle), and relational databases including schema design and query optimization.

We use coding agents daily (Claude Code, Cursor, and others) at every stage of the work: planning, building, reviewing, testing, and shipping. We treat that as core craft rather than a shortcut around the fundamentals. If you have a track record of shipping and owning complex software end-to-end, we want to hear from you.

Senior Full Stack Engineer $142,723 - $172,723 USD Architect and ship full stack features end to end, own the testing strategy for what you ship, and build internal tooling and testing infrastructure that makes the rest of the team faster. You will work without close supervision and hold the security and compliance bar our customers require. Nice to have: distributed systems and high availability architecture, regulated-environment security, open-source contributions, experience on remote-first teams.

Join our team: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mattermost/jobs/5379251008

Staff Full Stack Engineer $172,724 - $227,135 USD Set technical direction for the platform rather than for a feature area: architecture and roadmap across the stack, the standards for how the org uses coding agents, and the strategy for internal tooling and testing. You will influence direction across teams, partner with security and compliance on it, and mentor senior engineers. Nice to have: staff, principal or tech lead experience elsewhere, open-source maintainership, FedRAMP or ITAR familiarity, defense or critical infrastructure background.

Join our team: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mattermost/jobs/5405811008

Both roles have Canadian postings: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/mattermost

GC AI | Member of Technical Staff, Applied AI | REMOTE (US/Canada) | $180K–$430K + equity

GC AI is building an AI platform for in-house legal teams, helping lawyers draft, review, and analyze legal documents. The product is used by 1,800+ companies, including 150+ public companies and 25+ unicorns. GC AI raised a $60M Series B in November 2025 at a $555M valuation.

We’re hiring 5 engineers for the Applied AI team. This is a full-stack product engineering role with a strong AI execution layer — not an ML research or data science position.

We’re looking for engineers with: - Deep, recent TypeScript/JavaScript + React production experience - Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered product features - Experience with LLM orchestration, RAG, integrations, agents, and/or evaluation systems - Strong end-to-end product ownership, from architecture through production - A track record of shipping quickly and working closely with product

Strong signals include founding/founding-engineer experience, meaningful startup ownership, or experience scaling products at strong engineering companies before moving into a smaller high-ownership environment.

The Applied AI team also owns substantial model evaluation work as new models ship, and builds internal frameworks that allow the team to prototype and productionize new AI capabilities quickly. Location: Remote across the US and Canada Hybrid: Tue–Thu in-office if you’re within ~50 miles of San Mateo, CA or Provo, UT Comp: $180K–$430K + equity Openings: 5 Visa: H-1B transfers supported; no new visa sponsorship

Interested? Email mernaahmedemara13@gmail.com with the subject: GC AI – Applied AI Please include: - Your LinkedIn profile - Current location - A short description of an AI/LLM feature you personally shipped to production - GitHub / portfolio if relevant

Lokker.com | Data Scientist, Classification and Scoring | REMOTE: North America / Europe, UTC-8 to UTC+2 | Full-time

Lokker is a privacy platform. We continuously analyze websites, applications, third-party technologies and data flows to identify privacy, security and consent risks in production. We have built a large proprietary dataset from years of observing real-world digital behavior, and we are hiring a data scientist to help us expand and improve the classification, scoring and risk intelligence built on it.

You will develop and improve models that classify digital activity, identify meaningful privacy and security behaviors, and assess the confidence and significance of findings.

Looking for 2 to 4 years of production experience in data science and machine learning. Strong Python and SQL, pandas or Polars, scikit-learn and modern classification techniques, familiarity with model evaluation and explainability. Practical experience in training and evaluating supervised classification models on real PRODUCTION data, practical LLM experience beyond simple demonstrations, and curiosity about how websites and internet technologies actually behave. You do not need a privacy or adtech background. We will teach the domain.

You will work closely with engineering, product and privacy experts, and what you build goes directly into the product.

IMPORTANT: the timezone range above is a hard requirement, not a preference. We cannot make an exception.

ON APPLICATIONS: we assume you used AI to help write it. So do we. What we cannot do is verify a claim that exists only in the document you sent us, so make sure the skills you claim are visible somewhere public: LinkedIn with real dates and role detail, GitHub, papers, Kaggle, a writeup, a talk. If your best work is under NDA, say so and describe it in your own words.

A human reads every application. No keyword filter, no automated rejection.

Apply: https://lokker.com/careers/openings/data-scientist-classific...

PlantingSpace | Full-time | Remote (EU time zone) + Quarterly Meet-ups | https://planting.space

We're building a system that represents domain knowledge as modular probabilistic models — making analysis rigorous and transparent. Users can connect these models flexibly into larger structures. The system enforces consistency across them, and propagates uncertainty through each step. Our first applications are in finance and scientific research, with use cases ranging from equity valuation and distress monitoring, to particle physics.

We're hiring for the following openings: * Technical Project Manager

* Backend Software Engineer

* Quantitative Modelling Engineer

* Analytic Learning Algorithm Researcher

* Product Managers and Business Development

* Domain Experts - Valuation, Quantitative Default-Probability, or Interest Rate Prediction Models: to collaborate on use cases, from opportunity validation through production

Find out more, and apply at: https://planting.space/joinus/

Audio/Video Collaboration company, worldwide | GMT-2 <--> GMT+2 | Remote | Full time or part time or contract

We have a new opening! We're a dynamic truly-global team developing high-end audio and video collaboration tools.

A long-term opportunity exist to be the architect and team lead for a new version of a widely-used multimedia product based on existing proven patterns, but expanded to new platforms and capabilities. You must have a strong background in audio DSP, networked audio and cross-platform architecture. European timezone only.

We bring beautiful, complex systems to life. Our customers LOVE us. We have small teams: you work closely with the product owners and your input and expertise is meaningful and has an impact.

We're a 100% remote company in business for many years supporting the film, media and broadcast industry. Celebrated for our attention to technical detail and for solving hard problems, we're working on vital technology. There's something interesting going on every day and you'd have the opportunity to be part of driving how the industry moves forward in a post-pandemic world. You'll be part of a team of experts working 100% remotely.

You must have a strong background in audio DSP, networked audio and cross-platform architecture.

Please send resume to hello@loopcontrol.io that shows experience in the above-mentioned required areas and you are in timezone GMT-2 <--> GMT+2. We respond to all valid candidates. We strive for diversity and welcome all persons to apply. 4DWW possible. Family friendly / flexi-time.

Solace Health | Multiple Engineering Roles | REMOTE (US) | Full-time | No visa sponsorship offered

We're hiring Typescript Engineers (full-stack, backend, and platform) on all our core groups.

We're Solace Health. In 4.5 years, we've provided free healthcare advocacy to over 200K patients on Medicare, and just begun opening access to everyone in the US. We exist to make sure nobody in the US has to navigate their healthcare journey alone. We hit Unicorn status after our February Series-C led by IVP, bringing us to $207M raised and a $1B valuation. Compensation and benefits are highly competitive and include equity.

Open Roles

- Senior Full Stack Engineer ($150k-$200k) - Senior Backend Engineer ($150k-$200k) - Staff Software Engineer ($200k-$225k, Fullstack or Backend lean) - Senior Platform Engineer ($150k-$175k) - Technical Lead ($200k-$230k, player/coach people managers)

Tech Stack Typescript with ReactJS and NodeJS plus NestJS, PostgreSQL, GCP, SQL, TypeORM, shadcn for our UI Library and GCP. K8s for platform.

APPLY HERE https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/Solace?utm_source=x4QJmBQEg7

If you want to build fast with high autonomy and believe in strong typing as much as we do, we'd love to hear from you!

Baton | San Francisco, CA (Hybrid) | Full-Time

Baton (baton.io) is Ryder's in-house product development group focused on harnessing emerging technologies to redefine transportation and logistics. With $10B in freight under management, our technology reaches every part of the U.S. economy. We design and ship category-defining software that enables Ryder and its 50,000+ customers—including some of the world's most well-known brands—to plan and execute freight intelligently, efficiently, and cost-effectively. Our work includes everything from customer-facing software to the data platform that will power the next era of innovation at Ryder.

Baton's mission: enable supply chain on autopilot.

Ryder acquired Baton in 2022 to power its next wave of digital products. We operate at startup speed, with Fortune 500 reach. If you have a passion for solving complex problems and creating impact for the engine of the American economy, you'll love it here.
